item.title: [−1] Brent climbs over 2% to about $102.50 as Iran steps up attacks on Hormuz tankers
item.description:
A dozen attacks hit between 28 September and 2 October; Tuesday's Hormuz flows were the lowest since late July. US Gulf producers are shutting in output ahead of a possible hurricane. Escalating, despite faster IEA stock releases.

Metals, cement & chemicals: mild headwind (−1) — Crude-linked inputs costlier

Why it matters: Crude above $100 widens India's import bill, keeps fuel inflation and rupee pressure high, and squeezes airlines, paint and fuel retailers.

Market gauges: Fiscal & trade balance −2, Inflation outlook −1, Rupee −1

Confidence: high · horizon: weeks
